Strip newlines produces single-line paragraphs

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"strip_newlines\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>First paragraph.</p><p>Second paragraph.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
